text:
### Observed differences

- The largest change is an exchange between A05 and A10. Before, A05 ran in every case — about 4.2 executions per case, repeated in about 77 in 100 cases, around two-thirds of the way through the case (mean relative event position about 0.67) — while A10 ran in about 47 in 100 cases (about 1.9 executions per case overall, about 4 in each case containing it, repeated in about 34 in 100) around one-third through (about 0.32). In the later window, A10 runs in every case (about 4.1 executions, repeated in about 75 in 100, position about 0.67) and A05 in about 50 in 100 cases (about 2.2 per case overall, still about 4.4 per containing case, repeated in about 40 in 100, position about 0.33). [OCC001, OCC003, POS001, POS003]
- The inflow moved with the exchange: A06, which led only to A05 before (all of its ~199 observed outgoing transitions), leads only to A10 in the later window; A11 and A15 each sent about half of their outgoing transitions to A05 before and now send about half to A10; A14 sent about 51 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A10 before and now sends about 53 in 100 to A05. [DIR002, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- The outflow partially exchanged: A05 previously fed A08 (about 52 in 100) or A09 (about 48) and now feeds A17 (about 52) or A08 (about 48); A10 previously fed A17 (about 54) or A16 (about 46) and now feeds A16 (about 52) or A09 (about 48). A09 thus moved from A05's to A10's output and A17 from A10's to A05's, while A05→A08 and A10→A16 remained in place. [DIR001, DIR003]
- Co-occurrence flipped the same way: A09, A11, A14 and A15 occur in every case in both windows; before they always co-occurred with A05, in the later window always with A10. A17 ran in exactly the same ~47 in 100 cases as A10 before and now runs only in the ~50 in 100 cases containing A05; A05 itself now never appears without A10. [REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL009, REL020, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL026]
- Typical distances followed the exchange: before, A14 was typically 3 steps before A05 and about 1 step before A10; in the later window it is typically 3 steps before A10 and about 1 step before A05. [LAG005, LAG007]
- A08 and A16 moved with their hosts: A08 fell from about 68 to 34 in 100 cases (position about 0.66 → 0.33) and now occurs only in cases that also contain A10; A16 rose from about 30 to 67 in 100 cases (position about 0.33 → 0.67) and now always co-occurs with A10. Their gap profiles to A14 also exchanged: A14→A08 was almost always 4 steps apart before and is now typically 2, while A14→A16 is now almost always 4 steps apart. [OCC002, OCC004, POS002, POS004, REL013, REL014, REL025, LAG006, LAG008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A05 and A10 exchanged their places in the flow, together with their connections. Before, A05 was the mandatory, repeated activity of the later part of the case (every case, about 4 executions, around two-thirds through) and A10 an optional earlier activity (about 47 in 100 cases, around one-third through); in the later window A10 holds the first profile and A05 the second. The wiring moved with them: A06 now feeds A10 instead of A05, A11 and A15 feed A10 about half the time instead of A05, A14 feeds A05 instead of A10, and the branch activities reattached — A09 now follows A10 and A17 follows A05, where before A09 followed A05 and A17 followed A10. [OCC001, OCC003, POS001, POS003, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]

This goes well beyond what chance sampling would produce: 55 control-flow items qualified against roughly 0.46 expected without a change, and the exchange is observed directly and consistently across successor distributions, co-occurrence, positions and occurrence counts rather than resting on a single relation — for example, the always-present activities A09/A11/A14/A15 switch from accompanying A05 to accompanying A10, and A05 never appears without A10 in the later window. [REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL020, REL022, REL023, REL024]

Limitation: the evidence cannot fully distinguish a genuine exchange of the two activities' positions from a removal and re-insertion of two similar blocks at the same points of the flow, and with 200 cases per window the exact shares need not match one-for-one (A05 now about 2.2 executions per containing case versus A10's former 1.9; A08 now 34 versus A16's former 30 in 100 cases). [OCC001, OCC003, OCC002, OCC004]

Other differences: the A08 and A16 changes described above behave as consequences of the same exchange — each keeps its original parent (A05→A08, A10→A16) while its participation and position scale with that parent's new role; minor redistributions in the repeat gaps of A05, A08, A10 and A16 and in A17's gaps to A05/A10 show no clear direction of their own. [LAG001, LAG003, LAG004, LAG009, LAG010, LAG011]
